table.retrieve:
SELECT
	IncentiveDocCode = IncentiveSheet.IncentiveDocCode, 
	DebitAccount = (SELECT AC.Name FROM Accounts AC WHERE Ac.AccCode = IncentiveSheet.DrAccCode),   
	CreditAccount = (SELECT AC.Name FROM Accounts AC WHERE Ac.AccCode = IncentiveSheet.CrAccCode),   
	DrAccCode=IncentiveSheet.DrAccCode,
	CrAccCode=IncentiveSheet.CrAccCode,
	Date=IncentiveSheet.Date,   
	UserCode=IncentiveSheet.UserCode,   
	Posted=IncentiveSheet.Posted,   
	PostDate=IncentiveSheet.PostDate,   
	GLVochCode=IncentiveSheet.GLVochCode,   
	StartDate=IncentiveSheet.StartDate,   
	EndDate=IncentiveSheet.EndDate,   
	Remarks=IncentiveSheet.Remarks,   
	Amount = IncentiveSheet.Amount,   
	ICode=IncentiveSheetDetail.ICode,   
	AliasName=(SELECT I.CustomICode FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = IncentiveSheetDetail.ICode),   
	ItemName=(SELECT I.Name FROM Item I WHERE I.ICode = IncentiveSheetDetail.ICode),   
	Qty=IncentiveSheetDetail.Qty,   
	IncentiveRate=IncentiveSheetDetail.IncentiveRate,   
	RowID=IncentiveSheetDetail.RowID  
FROM IncentiveSheet,   
	IncentiveSheetDetail  
WHERE 
	( IncentiveSheetDetail.IncentiveDocCode = :ai_code ) AND
	( IncentiveSheetDetail.IncentiveDocCode = IncentiveSheet.IncentiveDocCode )    
ORDER BY
	RowID
